method: Each shape of proof an emailed link can carry is presented to the deployed /auth/callback against the real provider. Every proof is invalid by construction, so no account is touched and no email is sent; the request the client makes is the evidence. Case A seeds a PKCE code verifier, because with none the SDK throws locally and sends nothing — the same reason the original defect could not be seen from outside.
defectsClosed: exchangeCodeForSession was handed window.location.href; its parameter is an auth code, so no click could ever have produced a session
the paste field stripped every non-digit, so the only proof the default email template sends could not be entered
a pkce_-prefixed token was redeemed as a raw token, which hashes it twice and always fails
note: No credential, key or address appears in this artifact by construction: only booleans, endpoint paths and body key names are recorded.
